get.description: Liveness check. Public, no session required.

post.description: Settings -> Account (M8). Ends every other session; this browser gets a new one.
Log out every other session of the admin; this one stays.

get.description: Everything the user entered, as one JSON file (a download).

post.description:
Check an export file completely, then (unless ``dry_run``) write it in one transaction,
after copying the database. Every problem is a 422 in the usual list format, with ``loc``
pointing into the file (``["body", "devices", 3, "services", 1, "port"]``); nothing is
written then.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api Categories Get

delete.description: Devices in this category stay, without a category.

get.description:
Device totals, status counts, counts by category, recently edited and down devices,
computed from the database on every request; plus whether the monitor looks stuck.

schema.title: Response List Devices Api Devices Get

put.description: Move devices on the map (M5). All or nothing; does not count as an edit.

patch.description: Partial update. Fields left out stay unchanged; ``services`` replaces the list.

delete.description: Also deletes the device's services, links and status history.

schema.title: Response List Links Api Links Get

patch.description: Partial update. The status monitor uses the new values within a few seconds.

CategoryUpdate.title: CategoryUpdate
CategoryUpdate.description: Partial update: fields left out stay unchanged. None of them can be null.

DeviceSaved.title: DeviceSaved
DeviceSaved.description:
Response to create and update: the device plus warnings (for example a shared IP).

Warnings have the same shape as validation errors, but the device was saved.

DeviceStatus.title: DeviceStatus
DeviceStatus.description:
What the status dot shows (owner decision, M6). Not a column: computed from the cached
status and the settings by ``services.status.status_of``.

DeviceUpdate.title: DeviceUpdate
DeviceUpdate.description:
Partial update: fields left out stay unchanged; null clears a field that can be empty.

``services``, if given, replaces the device's services as a whole. The vendor follows the
MAC address; the map position has its own endpoint (``PUT /api/devices/positions``).

ImportCounts.title: ImportCounts
ImportCounts.description: What the import does (dry run) or did to one kind of record.

IssueOut.title: IssueOut
IssueOut.description: A validation error or warning, in FastAPI's error item shape (decision M3).

LinkCreate.title: LinkCreate
LinkCreate.description: Links are undirected: A-B and B-A are the same link.

LinkOut.title: LinkOut
LinkOut.description: ``device_a_id`` is always the smaller id (brief section 6).

LinkUpdate.title: LinkUpdate
LinkUpdate.description: Partial update. The two devices cannot change: delete the link and create a new one.

PasswordChange.title: PasswordChange
PasswordChange.description:
Settings -> Account (M8). A wrong current password is a 422 on ``current_password``
(not a 401: the session is fine), counted like a failed login.

PositionsUpdate.title: PositionsUpdate
PositionsUpdate.description:
New map positions for some devices (M5). Moving a node is not an edit: it does not
change ``updated_at``. All are checked before any is saved.

SessionsOut.title: SessionsOut
SessionsOut.description: Live sessions of the admin other than the one asking (M8, Settings -> Account).

SettingsOut.title: SettingsOut
SettingsOut.description: The settings in effect: stored values, or the defaults for values never changed.

SettingsUpdate.title: SettingsUpdate
SettingsUpdate.description:
Partial update: fields left out stay unchanged; null is not allowed.

The timeout must be at most half the interval, so a check always ends well before the
next round (brief section 4).

StatusCounts.title: StatusCounts
StatusCounts.description: How many devices have each status (the words are the frontend's, M6).
